words.enDefinition: fixed appointment times offered for visiting a rental

examples.en: The leasing office only offers viewing slots on weekday afternoons this month.
examples.zh: 租赁处这个月只在工作日下午安排「看房时段」。

examples.en: All the viewing slots for Saturday were gone within an hour.
examples.zh: 周六的「看房时段」一小时内就被抢光了。

words.enDefinition: a message asking to arrange an apartment showing

examples.en: I sent a viewing request through the app but nobody replied for two days.
examples.zh: 我在 App 上提交了「看房申请」，但两天都没人回复。

examples.en: Submit a viewing request early because good apartments get snapped up quickly.
examples.zh: 尽早提交「看房申请」，抢手的公寓很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: check a scheduled showing is still going ahead

examples.en: Text the agent the night before to confirm the viewing time.
examples.zh: 前一晚给中介发消息「确认看房」时间。

examples.en: Please reply by Friday to confirm the viewing so the landlord can plan ahead.
examples.zh: 请在周五前回复「确认看房」，方便房东提前安排。

words.enDefinition: move a scheduled showing to a different time

examples.en: My midterm ran long, so I had to reschedule the viewing for Thursday.
examples.zh: 期中考试拖堂了，我不得不「改约看房」到周四。

examples.en: Can we reschedule the viewing to tomorrow morning instead of tonight?
examples.zh: 我们能「改约看房」到明天上午吗？今晚不方便。

words.enDefinition: a return visit to a flat before deciding

examples.en: I loved the place, but I booked a second viewing to double-check.
examples.zh: 我很喜欢那个地方，但还是约了「二次看房」再确认一遍。

examples.en: Bring your tape measure to the second viewing and measure the bedroom.
examples.zh: 去「二次看房」时带上卷尺，量一量卧室。

words.enDefinition: a recorded video that shows a property room by room

examples.en: The agent sent a video walkthrough because we could not visit until Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五才能到，中介就发来了一段「逐间视频导览」。

examples.en: I paused the video walkthrough to check whether the desk would fit by the window.
examples.zh: 我暂停了「逐间视频导览」，想看看窗边能不能放下书桌。

words.enDefinition: ask someone to unlock a door so you can enter

examples.en: I got there early and texted the agent, 'Please let me in.'
examples.zh: 我到早了，就给中介发消息说：请「让我进去」。

examples.en: The gate was locked, so I called the property manager to let me in.
examples.zh: 大门锁着，我打电话请物业经理「让我进去」。

collocations: let me in through the side door
ask the concierge to let me in

words.enDefinition: remotely unlock a building door for a visitor

examples.en: When you arrive at the gate, ring the intercom and I will buzz you in.
examples.zh: 你到大门口时按对讲机，我帮你「门禁放行」。

examples.en: The landlord buzzed me in from the leasing office across town.
examples.zh: 房东在城另一头的租赁办公室远程「门禁放行」让我进了楼。

words.enDefinition: a door speaker system for talking and remote unlocking

examples.en: Press the intercom button and wait for the agent to answer.
examples.zh: 按一下「门禁对讲机」，等中介应答。

examples.en: The building intercom was broken, so the agent met us downstairs.
examples.zh: 楼的「门禁对讲机」坏了，中介直接下楼接我们。

words.enDefinition: a number typed on a keypad to unlock a door

examples.en: She texted me the door code before I arrived at the flat.
examples.zh: 我到公寓之前，她把「门禁密码」发给了我。

examples.en: Change the door code often if your building shares it with couriers.
examples.zh: 如果「门禁密码」和快递员共用，就要经常更换。

words.enDefinition: the keypad number that opens an outer building gate

examples.en: Ask for the gate code before your viewing, or you will be stuck outside.
examples.zh: 看房前先要「大门门禁密码」，不然你会被关在外面。

examples.en: The gate code changes every month, so check with the manager.
examples.zh: 「大门门禁密码」每月都会换，记得跟管理员确认。

words.enDefinition: a small electronic tag tapped to unlock shared doors

examples.en: Each resident gets a key fob for the gym and the main gate.
examples.zh: 每位住户都有一枚「门禁钥匙扣」，用于健身房和大门。

examples.en: My key fob stopped working, so security had to reprogram it.
examples.zh: 我的「门禁钥匙扣」失灵了，保安只好重新写卡。

words.enDefinition: press the bell outside a door to announce yourself

examples.en: Ring the doorbell twice because the chime inside is very quiet.
examples.zh: 按两下「门铃」，屋里的铃声很小。

examples.en: The landlord asked us to ring the doorbell instead of calling.
examples.zh: 房东让我们「按门铃」而不要打电话。

words.enDefinition: lobby staff who help residents and receive parcels

examples.en: Ask the concierge to watch your luggage during the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时可以把行李寄放在「大楼礼宾」那里。

examples.en: A friendly concierge greeted us and rang the unit for our viewing.
examples.zh: 一位友善的「大楼礼宾」接待了我们，还帮我们按了房间的对讲。

words.enDefinition: a small door lens for checking who is outside

examples.en: Always check the peephole before you open the door to strangers.
examples.zh: 给陌生人开门前，一定先看「猫眼」。

examples.en: The agent showed us the wide-angle peephole on the new door.
examples.zh: 中介给我们演示了新门上的广角「猫眼」。

words.enDefinition: a heavy key-operated lock bolt for extra security

examples.en: Make sure the deadbolt works smoothly before you sign anything.
examples.zh: 签字之前，先确认「防盗锁栓」开关顺畅。

examples.en: Ask whether the deadbolt was added recently or came with the door.
examples.zh: 问问「防盗锁栓」是新装的，还是原有门就带的。

words.enDefinition: an agent who shows and rents out apartments

examples.en: Our leasing agent met us at the lobby with the keys.
examples.zh: 「租赁经纪人」带着钥匙在大堂等我们。

examples.en: The leasing agent said two other students had viewed it that morning.
examples.zh: 「租赁经纪人」说当天上午已有两个学生看过房。

words.enDefinition: the office handling showings, applications, and rent for a building

examples.en: Stop by the leasing office to pick up the floor plans.
examples.zh: 顺便去「租赁办公室」拿几份户型图。

examples.en: The leasing office closes at six, so go right after class.
examples.zh: 「租赁办公室」六点关门，下课后直接过去。

words.enDefinition: a British agent managing rentals on behalf of landlords

examples.en: Our letting agent emailed the inventory checklist before we moved in.
examples.zh: 入住前，「出租中介」把物品清点单发到了我们邮箱。

examples.en: The letting agent charges a holding fee, so ask about it early.
examples.zh: 「出租中介」会收预留费，最好早点问清楚。

words.enDefinition: someone considering renting a particular unit

examples.en: As a prospective tenant, you should ask what the rent covers.
examples.zh: 作为「意向租客」，你应该问清房租包含什么。

examples.en: Three prospective tenants waited outside while I inspected the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我检查厨房时，三个「意向租客」在外面等着。

words.enDefinition: an apartment or house offered for rent

examples.en: The rental unit comes unfurnished, so budget for a bed and desk.
examples.zh: 这套「出租单元」不带家具，要预算好床和书桌。

examples.en: Photos online made the rental unit look brighter than reality.
examples.zh: 网上的照片让「出租单元」看起来比实际亮堂。

words.enDefinition: the way rooms are arranged inside a home

examples.en: I like the open layout because the living room gets afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这种开放的「户型格局」，客厅下午有阳光。

examples.en: The agent said the layout is popular with international students.
examples.zh: 中介说这个「户型格局」很受留学生欢迎。

words.enDefinition: floor area measured in square feet

examples.en: At nine hundred dollars a month, the square footage is a good deal.
examples.zh: 月租九百美元，这个「住房面积」算划算了。

examples.en: Check the square footage, because photos can make rooms look bigger.
examples.zh: 核对一下「住房面积」，照片会把房间拍得显大。

words.enDefinition: a unit with outside walls on two sides

examples.en: The corner unit gets light from two sides all morning.
examples.zh: 这套「边户」一上午两面都有光。

examples.en: We chose the corner unit because it only shares walls with one neighbor.
examples.zh: 我们选了「边户」，因为只跟一家邻居共墙。

words.enDefinition: the highest storey of a building

examples.en: The top floor unit costs a bit more but no one walks above you.
examples.zh: 「顶楼」贵一点点，但楼上没人走动。

examples.en: Our top floor apartment stays quiet, though the stairs are a workout.
examples.zh: 「顶楼」公寓很安静，就是爬楼梯费劲。

words.enDefinition: the storey at street level

examples.en: The ground floor unit is cheaper but strangers pass the windows all day.
examples.zh: 「底楼」便宜，但窗外整天有陌生人经过。

examples.en: Ground floor flats stay cool in summer, which I liked during the viewing.
examples.zh: 「底楼」公寓夏天凉快，看房时我就很喜欢这点。

words.enDefinition: a flat partly or fully below street level

examples.en: Basement units cost less, but check the windows for damp first.
examples.zh: 「地下室单元」便宜，但先检查窗户有没有潮气。

examples.en: The basement apartment felt much darker than the online photos suggested.
examples.zh: 那套「地下室单元」比网上照片看起来暗得多。

words.enDefinition: having kitchen and living space share one room

examples.en: The open-plan kitchen makes the small flat feel twice as big.
examples.zh: 「开放式」厨房让小公寓显得大了一倍。

examples.en: I chose the open-plan layout because I hate feeling boxed in.
examples.zh: 我选了「开放式」布局，因为讨厌憋闷的感觉。

words.enDefinition: flooring made of polished wooden planks

examples.en: The hardwood floor in the bedroom was scratched by the previous tenant's bed.
examples.zh: 卧室的「硬木地板」被前租客的床划花了。

examples.en: Hardwood floors look classy, but ask if you can put down rugs.
examples.zh: 「硬木地板」看着体面，但要问能否铺地毯。

words.enDefinition: a private bathroom attached to a bedroom

examples.en: The en-suite bathroom means you never queue for the shower.
examples.zh: 有「卧室相连的套内卫浴」就不用排队洗澡了。

examples.en: Rooms with an en-suite cost about fifty dollars more each month.
examples.zh: 带「卧室相连的套内卫浴」的房间每月贵约五十美元。

words.enDefinition: a very small cooking area with basic equipment

examples.en: The kitchenette has a two-ring stove, so forget cooking big dinners.
examples.zh: 「小厨房」只有两个灶眼，大餐就别想了。

examples.en: She demonstrated how the kitchenette fridge clicks shut during the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时她演示了「小厨房」的冰箱怎么关严。

words.enDefinition: a level-entry shower with no tub to climb

examples.en: I tested the walk-in shower and the water got hot in seconds.
examples.zh: 我试了「步入式淋浴间」，几秒钟就出热水。

examples.en: A walk-in shower is easier to clean than a bathtub.
examples.zh: 「步入式淋浴间」比浴缸好打扫。

collocations: the walk-in shower has good pressure

words.enDefinition: a closet large enough to stand inside

examples.en: Her walk-in closet easily fits four suitcases plus winter coats.
examples.zh: 她的「步入式衣帽间」轻松装下四个行李箱加冬衣。

examples.en: Check the walk-in closet light during the viewing, it often gets skipped.
examples.zh: 看房时记得开一下「步入式衣帽间」的灯，这里常被漏掉。

words.enDefinition: a closet frame fixed into the bedroom wall

examples.en: The built-in wardrobe saves space, so we skipped buying a dresser.
examples.zh: 有「内置衣柜」就省空间，我们没再买五斗柜。

examples.en: Open the built-in wardrobe during the viewing to check the shelves.
examples.zh: 看房时打开「内置衣柜」，检查一下隔板。

words.enDefinition: the storage available inside closets and wardrobes

examples.en: There is barely any closet space, so we will need a rack.
examples.zh: 几乎没什么「壁橱收纳空间」，得再买个挂衣架。

examples.en: Compared with my dorm locker, this closet space feels absolutely enormous.
examples.zh: 和宿舍柜子比，这里的「壁橱收纳空间」大得惊人。

words.enDefinition: room for keeping boxes, luggage, and seasonal items

examples.en: Ask the manager whether the basement offers extra storage space for bikes.
examples.zh: 问问管理员，地下室有没有放自行车的额外「储物空间」。

examples.en: There is storage space above the wardrobe, perfect for my suitcases.
examples.zh: 衣柜上方有「储物空间」，放行李箱正合适。

words.enDefinition: a paved outdoor area beside a home

examples.en: The patio fits a small table, perfect for morning coffee before lectures.
examples.zh: 「露台」放得下小桌子，上课前喝杯咖啡正合适。

examples.en: During the viewing, we checked whether the patio door actually locked.
examples.zh: 看房时我们特意确认「露台」的门真能锁上。

words.enDefinition: the small area just inside the front door

examples.en: The entryway has hooks for coats and a spot for shoes.
examples.zh: 「玄关」有挂外套的钩子和放鞋的地方。

examples.en: Check the entryway floor for scratches when you view the flat.
examples.zh: 看房时留意「玄关」地面有没有划痕。

words.enDefinition: a building-wide system warming every room

examples.en: Central heating is included in the rent, which saves a lot in winter.
examples.zh: 房租包含「中央供暖」，冬天能省不少钱。

examples.en: Ask when the central heating is switched on each autumn.
examples.zh: 问问每年秋天「中央供暖」什么时候开。

words.enDefinition: a metal panel that heats a single room

examples.en: The agent asked whether the radiator in the front bedroom was working that morning.
examples.zh: 中介问那天早上临街那间卧室的「暖气片」有没有正常工作。

examples.en: The bedroom radiator has a bleed valve that sometimes hisses loudly.
examples.zh: 卧室「暖气片」的放气阀有时会嘶嘶作响。

words.enDefinition: a wall control that sets room temperature

examples.en: The thermostat is in the hallway, and the landlord sets a range.
examples.zh: 「温控器」在走廊，房东限定了温度范围。

examples.en: Ask how low the thermostat can go before the pipes risk freezing.
examples.zh: 问问「温控器」最低能调到多少，以免管道冻裂。

words.enDefinition: the tank or unit supplying hot water

examples.en: The water heater is in the closet, and it rumbles loudly at night.
examples.zh: 「热水器」在壁橱里，晚上咕噜声很响。

examples.en: A small water heater means the second shower waits for the tank.
examples.zh: 「热水器」小的话，第二个人洗澡就得等水箱烧热。

words.enDefinition: the nozzle spraying water in a shower

examples.en: Swap the shower head for a pressure-boosting one, they cost almost nothing.
examples.zh: 换个增压「花洒」，几乎不花钱。

examples.en: Scale had blocked the shower head, but vinegar fixed it quickly.
examples.zh: 水垢堵住了「花洒」，用白醋一泡就好了。

words.enDefinition: a fan pulling steam and smells out of bathrooms

examples.en: Test the exhaust fan during the viewing, a silent one spreads mold.
examples.zh: 看房时试一下「排风扇」，不转的话容易长霉。

examples.en: Run the exhaust fan after hot showers to protect the paint.
examples.zh: 洗完热水澡开一下「排风扇」，保护墙面油漆。

words.enDefinition: a grinder under the sink shredding food scraps

examples.en: The agent demonstrated the garbage disposal, and it swallowed an orange peel.
examples.zh: 中介演示了「厨余粉碎机」，橙子皮直接搅碎了。

examples.en: Never put rice in the garbage disposal unless you want a plumber visit.
examples.zh: 别把米饭倒进「厨余粉碎机」，不然就得请管道工了。

words.enDefinition: a device that sounds an alarm when it detects smoke

examples.en: I asked the agent where to find the smoke detector during our viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时，我问了中介「烟雾报警器」在哪里。

examples.en: The caretaker showed us the smoke detector in the hallway outside our bedrooms.
examples.zh: 管理员给我们指了卧室外面走廊上的「烟雾报警器」。

words.enDefinition: a device that sounds an alarm when it detects carbon monoxide

examples.en: Our flat has a carbon monoxide detector in the hallway near the utility cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们公寓在杂物柜附近的走廊里装了「一氧化碳报警器」。

examples.en: The carbon monoxide detector was missing, so I asked the landlord to install one.
examples.zh: 屋里没有「一氧化碳报警器」，我请房东装了一个。

words.enDefinition: the wall control that turns a room light on

examples.en: Flick every light switch during the viewing, one by the bed was dead.
examples.zh: 看房时把每个「电灯开关」都按一遍，床头那个是坏的。

examples.en: The bedroom light switch is behind the door, which annoys me nightly.
examples.zh: 卧室「电灯开关」在门后，每天晚上都让我心烦。

words.enDefinition: a permanent ceiling or wall lamp

examples.en: One light fixture was missing in the hallway, just bare wires.
examples.zh: 走廊少了一盏「灯具」，只剩裸露的电线。

examples.en: Ask if the light fixtures stay when the current tenant moves out.
examples.zh: 问问现租客搬走后「灯具」会不会留下。

words.enDefinition: a fan hung overhead to move air

examples.en: The ceiling fan wobbles on high speed, so ask them to fix it.
examples.zh: 「吊扇」开高速会晃，让他们修一修。

examples.en: A quiet ceiling fan can replace air conditioning in early summer.
examples.zh: 初夏一台安静的「吊扇」就能替代空调。

words.enDefinition: a locked room or rack for residents' bicycles

examples.en: Bike storage is free here, which saves me campus parking fees.
examples.zh: 这里的「自行车存放区」免费，帮我省了校园停车费。

examples.en: Ask whether the bike storage needs a separate key or the same fob.
examples.zh: 问问「自行车存放区」是另配钥匙还是刷同一张门禁卡。

words.enDefinition: a shaft trash bags drop down from each floor

examples.en: The garbage chute on our floor stinks if people leave bags open.
examples.zh: 有人不扎紧垃圾袋的话，我们这层的「垃圾道」就会发臭。

examples.en: A garbage chute on the same floor is a real convenience at exam time.
examples.zh: 同一层有「垃圾道」，考试周倒垃圾省事多了。

words.enDefinition: the main door where residents and guests come in

examples.en: Meet the agent at the building entrance because visitors cannot get in alone.
examples.zh: 访客进不了楼，在「楼宇入口」和中介碰头吧。

examples.en: The building entrance needs a fob even on weekends, so plan ahead.
examples.zh: 周末「楼宇入口」也要刷门禁卡，提前安排好。

words.enDefinition: the staircase shaft connecting every floor

examples.en: The stairwell lighting was flickering, which the manager promised to fix.
examples.zh: 「楼梯间」的灯一闪一闪，管理员答应会修。

examples.en: Five flights up, the stairwell smelled faintly of someone's late-night noodles.
examples.zh: 爬五层楼，「楼梯间」里飘着谁家深夜煮泡面的味道。

words.enDefinition: an outside staircase for emergency use

examples.en: Never store boxes on the fire escape, the landlord checks monthly.
examples.zh: 千万别在「太平梯」堆纸箱，房东每月都会检查。

examples.en: The old fire escape looked rusty, so I asked when it was last inspected.
examples.zh: 「太平梯」锈迹斑斑，我问了上次检查是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: two glass panes sealing heat in and noise out

examples.en: Double glazing keeps the traffic noise down even with windows facing the street.
examples.zh: 就算窗临大街，「双层玻璃」也能压低车流噪音。

examples.en: Ask if the double glazing is original, old seals let cold drafts in.
examples.zh: 问问「双层玻璃」是不是原装的，老密封条会漏冷风。

words.enDefinition: the rubber strip around a window blocking drafts

examples.en: Run your finger along the window seal to feel for cracks.
examples.zh: 用手指沿「窗户密封条」摸一摸，查查有没有裂口。

examples.en: A worn window seal let cold air into the bedroom during our viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时，「窗户密封条」磨损，冷风从窗缝吹进了卧室。

words.enDefinition: a mesh panel keeping insects out of open windows

examples.en: Every window screen had a small tear, so summer mosquitoes are guaranteed.
examples.zh: 每扇「纱窗」都有小口子，夏天蚊子肯定少不了。

examples.en: Ask the landlord to mend the window screen before June.
examples.zh: 让房东六月前把「纱窗」补好。

collocations: the window screen keeps bugs out

words.enDefinition: water droplets forming on cold glass surfaces

examples.en: Heavy condensation on the bedroom window often means poor ventilation.
examples.zh: 卧室窗上「结露」严重，多半是通风不好。

examples.en: Wipe the condensation off each morning or the sill will go black.
examples.zh: 每天早上擦掉「结露」，不然窗台会发黑。

words.enDefinition: test how strongly water flows from taps and showers

examples.en: Always check the water pressure while the dishwasher runs, it drops badly.
examples.zh: 洗碗机运行时一定要「检查水压」，会掉得很厉害。

examples.en: The agent let me check the water pressure in both bathrooms myself.
examples.zh: 中介让我亲自在两个卫生间「检查水压」。

collocations: check the water pressure in the shower
ask to check the water pressure

words.enDefinition: the force of water coming out of taps

examples.en: The water pressure upstairs is weak whenever someone runs the washing machine.
examples.zh: 有人用洗衣机时，楼上的「水压」就变弱。

examples.en: Good water pressure was the deciding factor for me at that viewing.
examples.zh: 那次看房，好的「水压」成了我拍板的关键。

words.enDefinition: to open the faucet and let water flow for a while

examples.en: The agent offered to run the tap so we could see the water pressure.
examples.zh: 中介提出「打开水龙头」，让我们看看水压。

examples.en: I ran the taps in the kitchen while the agent held my notes.
examples.zh: 中介帮我拿笔记时，我在厨房「开水龙头」试了试水。

collocations: run the tap for a minute
run the taps in both bathrooms

words.enDefinition: flushing toilets during a viewing to check plumbing

examples.en: Do a flush test in both toilets before you commit to the lease.
examples.zh: 签租约前，两个马桶都做一次「冲水测试」。

examples.en: An awkward flush test revealed the toilet needed two presses to clear.
examples.zh: 一次尴尬的「冲水测试」发现，马桶要按两次才冲得干净。

words.enDefinition: testing windows and doors for cold air leaks

examples.en: Do a draft check by sliding a paper strip under each exterior door.
examples.zh: 在每扇外门下塞纸条，做个「漏风检查」。

examples.en: My draft check found the biggest leak behind the bedroom curtain.
examples.zh: 我做「漏风检查」时，发现最大的漏风点在卧室窗帘后面。

words.enDefinition: a pipe letting water escape onto floors or walls

examples.en: A leaking pipe under the sink had warped the cabinet floor.
examples.zh: 水槽下的「漏水管道」已把柜底泡变形了。

examples.en: Look under every sink for a leaking pipe or a damp ring.
examples.zh: 每个水槽下面都看看有没有「漏水管道」或潮圈。

collocations: a leaking pipe under the sink

words.enDefinition: a tap that keeps dripping after closing

examples.en: A leaky faucet is small, but it hints the plumbing is aging.
examples.zh: 「漏水的水龙头」事小，却说明管道老了。

examples.en: The leaky faucet in the kitchen kept me awake my first week.
examples.zh: 头一周，厨房「漏水的水龙头」滴得我睡不着。

words.enDefinition: a brown mark left where water has leaked

examples.en: A water stain on the ceiling means someone above had a leak.
examples.zh: 天花板上有「水渍」，说明楼上漏过水。

examples.en: Photograph every water stain before you sign the move-in inventory checklist.
examples.zh: 签入住物品清单前，把每处「水渍」都拍下来。

collocations: a water stain on the ceiling

words.enDefinition: harm to walls or floors caused by water

examples.en: Serious water damage near the window suggested the seal failed years ago.
examples.zh: 窗边严重的「水浸损坏」说明密封条几年前就失效了。

examples.en: The landlord promised the water damage was repaired before repainting.
examples.zh: 房东保证「水浸损坏」修复之后才重新刷的墙。

words.enDefinition: a wet-looking area on a wall or ceiling

examples.en: We found a damp patch above the wardrobe and asked when it first appeared.
examples.zh: 我们在衣柜上方发现一块「潮斑」，就问它最早是什么时候出现的。

examples.en: The agent photographed the damp patch so the landlord could arrange an inspection.
examples.zh: 中介把「潮斑」拍了下来，方便房东安排检查。

collocations: a damp patch on the ceiling

words.enDefinition: the wet-earth odor of a room with moisture problems

examples.en: A damp smell hit us the moment the agent opened the door.
examples.zh: 中介一开门，一股「潮湿气味」扑面而来。

examples.en: The damp smell was strongest in the bedroom closest to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 「潮湿气味」在离浴室最近的卧室最重。

collocations: the damp smell of the basement
get rid of the damp smell

words.enDefinition: an old moldy odor like a closed cellar

examples.en: A musty smell from the carpet is a classic sign of hidden mold.
examples.zh: 地毯冒出「霉味」是暗藏霉菌的典型信号。

examples.en: Air the room out, a musty smell usually fades after a week of windows open.
examples.zh: 开窗通风一周，「霉味」一般就散了。

collocations: a musty smell in the room
the musty smell of old carpet

words.enDefinition: a thin coating of fungal growth on a damp surface

examples.en: There was mildew along the shower tiles when we inspected the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我们查看浴室时，发现淋浴区瓷砖边缘有「霉斑」。

examples.en: I asked the agent whether the mildew on the window frame had been reported.
examples.zh: 我问中介窗框上的「霉斑」有没有人报修。

words.enDefinition: search corners and ceilings for fungal growth

examples.en: Look for mold behind the wardrobe, where the wall never gets air.
examples.zh: 在衣柜后面「查找霉菌」，那面墙从不透气。

examples.en: I looked for mould under the sink while the agent was talking.
examples.zh: 中介讲话时，我在水槽下「查找霉菌」。

collocations: look for mold in the corners
look for mold around the window

words.enDefinition: a split line running across a wall surface

examples.en: A hairline crack in the wall above the door is usually harmless.
examples.zh: 门上方墙面的细小「裂缝」通常无碍。

examples.en: Measure any crack in the wall, growing cracks need reporting fast.
examples.zh: 量一下墙上的每条「裂缝」，变宽的要赶紧上报。

collocations: a hairline crack in the wall
fill the crack in the wall
a crack in the wall is spreading

words.enDefinition: paint flaking or bubbling off walls

examples.en: Peeling paint around the window suggests moisture keeps getting in.
examples.zh: 窗户四周「漆面剥落」，说明水汽一直在渗。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to repaint the peeling paint before we moved in.
examples.zh: 房东答应入住前把「剥落的漆面」补刷好。

words.enDefinition: thin marks where furniture has scraped paint

examples.en: I noted several scratches on the wall where the old bed had stood.
examples.zh: 旧床靠过的墙上留了几道「划痕」，我都记了下来。

examples.en: Photograph the scratches on the wall so you are not blamed later.
examples.zh: 把「墙上划痕」拍下来，免得日后算到你头上。

collocations: note the scratches on the wall
photograph the scratches on the wall
scratches on the wall near the door

words.enDefinition: a dark streak left by shoes or furniture

examples.en: A magic eraser removes most scuff marks from painted hallway walls.
examples.zh: 魔术擦能擦掉走廊墙面上大部分「擦痕」。

examples.en: We added every scuff mark to the inventory checklist at move-in.
examples.zh: 入住时我们把每处「擦痕」都记进了物品清单。

words.enDefinition: floorboards that creak under each step

examples.en: The squeaky floor outside the bedroom will wake your roommate at 6 a.m.
examples.zh: 卧室外的地板「一走就吱呀响」，清晨六点准吵醒室友。

examples.en: Walk through the hall slowly and listen for a squeaky floor.
examples.zh: 慢慢走过走廊，听听哪里有「吱呀响的地板」。

collocations: a squeaky floor in the hallway

words.enDefinition: a discolored spot on carpet from spills

examples.en: Ask whether the carpet stain near the door will be cleaned professionally.
examples.zh: 问问门口那块「地毯污渍」会不会专业清洗。

examples.en: An old coffee carpet stain came out with the right spray.
examples.zh: 那块老旧的咖啡「地毯污渍」用对清洁剂就除掉了。

collocations: a carpet stain near the door

words.enDefinition: a cracked or chipped floor or wall tile

examples.en: One broken tile by the shower edge can cut your heel.
examples.zh: 淋浴间边缘一块「破损瓷砖」就可能划伤脚跟。

examples.en: List the broken tiles in the inspection report with close-up photos.
examples.zh: 把「破损瓷砖」连同特写照片一起写进验房报告。

collocations: a broken tile in the bathroom

words.enDefinition: droppings or gnaw marks showing insects or mice

examples.en: Look behind the stove for signs of pests, droppings look like black rice.
examples.zh: 到灶台后面找找「虫害迹象」，虫屎像黑米粒。

examples.en: The agent promised that the earlier signs of pests were fully treated.
examples.zh: 中介保证之前的「虫害迹象」已经彻底处理过。

collocations: signs of pests in the kitchen

words.enDefinition: a flat brown insect invading kitchens at night

examples.en: I saw one cockroach during the viewing and the agent pretended not to.
examples.zh: 看房时我看见一只「蟑螂」，中介装作没看见。

examples.en: Even one cockroach in daylight means there are many more hiding.
examples.zh: 白天见到一只「蟑螂」，说明暗处还有很多。

words.enDefinition: switch machines on during a viewing to confirm they work

examples.en: Test the appliances one by one, the dishwasher was the deal-breaker.
examples.zh: 逐台「测试家电」，洗碗机是成败关键。

examples.en: The agent smiled when I asked to test the appliances, nobody ever had.
examples.zh: 我提出要「测试家电」时中介笑了，说从来没人这么做过。

collocations: test the appliances with the agent

words.enDefinition: a machine that washes dishes automatically

examples.en: Run a short cycle to check the dishwasher drains without leaking.
examples.zh: 跑一个短程序，看看「洗碗机」排水漏不漏。

examples.en: A working dishwasher saves us at least an hour every single day.
examples.zh: 一台能用的「洗碗机」每天至少省我们一小时。

words.enDefinition: a washing machine and drying machine set

examples.en: The washer and dryer are stacked in the hallway closet, which saves floor space.
examples.zh: 「洗衣机和烘干机」上下叠放在走廊壁橱里，省地面空间。

examples.en: Since the unit has its own washer and dryer, I save on laundry costs.
examples.zh: 这套房自带「洗衣机和烘干机」，省下不少洗衣开销。

collocations: the washer and dryer are included

words.enDefinition: the frozen-food compartment of a fridge or a standalone chest

examples.en: The freezer is tiny, so bulk frozen dumplings are out of the question.
examples.zh: 「冰柜」太小，大袋速冻饺子就别想了。

examples.en: Check whether the freezer frosts up, old ones choke with ice fast.
examples.zh: 检查「冰柜」会不会结冰，老款很快就被冰堵死。

collocations: the freezer is full of ice

words.enDefinition: a washer and dryer inside your own apartment

examples.en: In-unit laundry was the one feature I refused to compromise on this year.
examples.zh: 今年「室内洗衣设施」是我唯一不肯让步的配置。

examples.en: Flats with in-unit laundry rent for about fifty dollars more here.
examples.zh: 带「室内洗衣设施」的公寓这里月租贵约五十美元。

words.enDefinition: mobile signal strength inside a building

examples.en: Cell reception dies in the bedroom, so check it during the viewing.
examples.zh: 卧室里「手机信号」很差，看房时一定要试。

examples.en: Walk every room with your phone to compare the cell reception.
examples.zh: 拿着手机走遍每个房间，比较「手机信号」。

words.enDefinition: the strength of wireless internet in each room

examples.en: The wifi signal barely reaches the study corner behind the kitchen wall.
examples.zh: 厨房那面墙后的学习角几乎收不到「无线信号」。

examples.en: Ask the current tenant whether the wifi signal drops during evening hours.
examples.zh: 问问现任租客，晚上「无线信号」会不会掉。

words.enDefinition: walls that let you hear neighbors through them

examples.en: Thin walls mean you will know your neighbor's alarm schedule by heart.
examples.zh: 「墙薄」的话，邻居闹钟几点响你都能背下来。

examples.en: Press your ear to the wall during the viewing, thin walls tell immediately.
examples.zh: 看房时把耳朵贴在墙上，「墙薄」立刻就能听出来。

words.enDefinition: material or design that blocks sound between rooms

examples.en: The soundproofing in this building is excellent, I never hear the elevator.
examples.zh: 这栋楼「隔音」极好，电梯声完全听不到。

examples.en: Poor soundproofing ruined my last flat, so I test it first now.
examples.zh: 上次租房就是吃了「隔音」差的亏，现在都先试再定。

words.enDefinition: parking a car on the public road outside

examples.en: Street parking needs a resident permit, which costs extra each year.
examples.zh: 「路边停车」要办居民许可，每年额外花钱。

examples.en: Ask about street parking rules before you rent with a car.
examples.zh: 有车的话，租房前先问清「路边停车」的规定。

words.enDefinition: check a room's size to see if furniture fits

examples.en: Measure the room before paying, my desk barely fits now.
examples.zh: 付钱前先「量房间尺寸」，我的书桌现在差点放不下。

examples.en: Bring a tape measure and measure the room wall by wall.
examples.zh: 带上卷尺，一面墙一面墙地「量房间尺寸」。

collocations: measure the room with a tape
measure the room before moving in

words.enDefinition: a retractable ruler for checking sizes and spaces

examples.en: A three-meter tape measure fits in your pocket during viewings.
examples.zh: 三米的「卷尺」看房时装进口袋就行。

examples.en: We forgot the tape measure and guessed wrong about the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们忘了带「卷尺」，沙发尺寸全估错了。

words.enDefinition: experience a place directly to judge it

examples.en: Visit at night to get a feel for the neighborhood's real noise.
examples.zh: 晚上再去一趟，「亲身感受」街区的真实噪音。

examples.en: Sitting in the empty bedroom helped me get a feel for the space.
examples.zh: 在空卧室里坐了一会儿，我才「亲身感受」到空间的大小。

collocations: get a feel for the place
get a feel for the neighborhood

words.enDefinition: move from room to room inspecting a flat

examples.en: Walk through the apartment slowly and check behind every door.
examples.zh: 慢慢「把公寓走一遍」，每扇门后都要看。

examples.en: We walked through the apartment twice before deciding to apply.
examples.zh: 我们「把公寓走了两遍」才决定申请。

collocations: walk through the apartment one last time
the agent walked us through the apartment

words.enDefinition: a guided tour of each room in a unit

examples.en: During the walkthrough, take photos of anything you would hate to pay for.
examples.zh: 「逐间查看」时，凡是怕赔钱的地方都拍照。

examples.en: The move-in walkthrough took twenty minutes and saved us a deposit fight.
examples.zh: 入住时的「逐间查看」花了二十分钟，省掉一场押金纠纷。

words.enDefinition: guide a visitor around a rental to view it

examples.en: The property manager offered to show the unit again on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 物业经理提出周六上午再「带看房源」一次。

examples.en: She showed the unit to three groups before we even applied.
examples.zh: 我们还没申请，她已经向三组人「带看」过了。

collocations: show the unit to prospective tenants

words.enDefinition: question the agent or tenants about people living nearby

examples.en: Ask about the neighbors before signing, thin walls make bad ones miserable.
examples.zh: 签字前先「打听邻居情况」，墙薄遇上差邻居会很难熬。

examples.en: I asked about the neighbors and learned the upstairs guy practices drums.
examples.zh: 我「打听了邻居」，得知楼上的人在练架子鼓。

collocations: remember to ask about the neighbors
ask the current tenant about the neighbors

words.enDefinition: watch carefully for something specific while looking around

examples.en: Keep an eye out for water stains when you view the ceiling corners.
examples.zh: 看天花板角落时，「留意观察」有没有水渍。

examples.en: Keep an eye out for outlets near the desk if you use two monitors.
examples.zh: 用双显示器的话，「留意」书桌附近有没有插座。

collocations: keep an eye out for mold
keep an eye out for damage
keep an eye out for scams

words.enDefinition: when you examine something more carefully

examples.en: On closer inspection, the fresh paint was hiding a damp patch.
examples.zh: 「细看之下」，新油漆底下藏着一块潮斑。

examples.en: The apartment looked perfect until, on closer inspection, the oven door hung crooked.
examples.zh: 公寓看上去完美，「细看之下」烤箱门却是歪的。

collocations: on closer inspection, it turned out that
on closer inspection of the wall

words.enDefinition: a viewing question about the building's age

examples.en: How old is the building? Older pipes often mean surprise leaks later.
examples.zh: 「这栋楼有多旧？」管道越老，之后越容易突然漏水。

examples.en: Before signing, I asked, how old is the building and when was the roof done?
examples.zh: 签字前我问了「这栋楼有多旧」、屋顶何时翻修过。

collocations: ask how old the building is
how old is the building exactly

words.enDefinition: choose immediately without waiting or negotiating
acceptedEnVariants: make a decision on the spot

examples.en: The agent said someone else was viewing at five, so I decided on the spot.
examples.zh: 中介说五点还有别人看房，我「当场决定」了。

examples.en: Good apartments in September go fast, so be ready to decide on the spot.
examples.zh: 九月好房子抢得快，做好「当场决定」的准备。

collocations: had to decide on the spot
ready to decide on the spot
decide on the spot or lose it

words.enDefinition: wait overnight before making a final decision

examples.en: The agent held the paperwork for a day so we could sleep on it.
examples.zh: 中介把文件留了一天，好让我们「考虑一晚再决定」。

examples.en: Never sign under pressure, you can always sleep on it and call tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别在压力下签字，大可「考虑一晚」明天再打电话。

words.enDefinition: your immediate feeling when you first see a place

examples.en: My first impression was the smell in the stairwell, not the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我的「第一印象」是楼梯间的味道，而不是厨房。

examples.en: Trust your first impression, but verify everything with your own photos.
examples.zh: 相信「第一印象」，但一切都要自己拍照核实。

words.enDefinition: kept in good repair by careful owners

examples.en: The well-maintained stairwell suggested that the landlord fixes things promptly.
examples.zh: 「保养良好」的楼梯间说明房东维修很及时。

examples.en: A well-maintained building usually means fewer surprise repair fights later.
examples.zh: 「保养良好」的楼，日后维修扯皮通常更少。

words.enDefinition: recently modernized with new fittings and finishes

examples.en: The newly renovated bathroom still smelled strongly of fresh paint.
examples.zh: 「新装修」的浴室还有很重的油漆味。

examples.en: Newly renovated flats photograph well but sometimes hide rushed wiring.
examples.zh: 「新装修」的公寓上镜好看，有时却藏着赶工的线路。

words.enDefinition: old and badly worn from lack of care

examples.en: The run-down lobby made everyone nervous about the invisible landlord.
examples.zh: 「破旧的」大堂让大家对见不到面的房东更不放心。

examples.en: A run-down building can still be a gem if the unit inside is decent.
examples.zh: 楼再「破旧」，只要屋里够好也可能是宝。

words.enDefinition: having plenty of space for your things

examples.en: The roomy kitchen finally gives us space for a real dining table.
examples.zh: 「宽敞的」厨房终于放得下一张正经餐桌。

examples.en: Compared with the dorm, even the bathroom here feels roomy.
examples.zh: 跟宿舍比，这里的浴室都显得「宽敞」。

words.enDefinition: a list recording the condition of everything at move-in

examples.en: Fill in the inventory checklist the day you get the keys.
examples.zh: 拿钥匙当天就要填好「入住物品清单」。

examples.en: Our inventory checklist noted a cracked wardrobe mirror, which saved our deposit.
examples.zh: 我们的「入住物品清单」记下了衣柜镜子的裂纹，押金因此保住了。

collocations: attach photos to the inventory checklist

words.enDefinition: a room-by-room check done when receiving the keys

examples.en: Schedule the move-in inspection before you hand over any money.
examples.zh: 交钱之前先安排「入住验房」。

examples.en: During the move-in inspection, we found a burn mark on the counter.
examples.zh: 「入住验房」时，我们发现台面上有块烫痕。

words.enDefinition: a documented record of a rental's condition for both parties

examples.en: Both of us signed the rental inspection report and kept scanned copies.
examples.zh: 我们俩都签了「租房验房报告」，并留了扫描件。

examples.en: Attach timestamped photos to the rental inspection report as proof.
examples.zh: 在「租房验房报告」上附上带时间戳的照片作为凭证。

collocations: attach photos to the rental inspection report
the rental inspection report protects your deposit

words.enDefinition: pictures proving the state of a place

examples.en: Take photo evidence of the carpet before the furniture arrives.
examples.zh: 家具进场前，先给地毯拍下「照片证据」。

examples.en: Photo evidence of existing damage settled the deposit argument in minutes.
examples.zh: 「照片证据」几分钟就解决了押金争执。

words.enDefinition: wear already present before you moved in

examples.en: Mark every bit of existing damage, or checkout will blame you.
examples.zh: 每一处「原有损坏」都要标注，不然退房时会赖你。

examples.en: The landlord accepted the existing damage once he saw our dated photos.
examples.zh: 房东看到我们带日期的照片后，承认了那些「原有损坏」。

words.enDefinition: record problems with notes, photos, and dates

examples.en: Document the damage with dated photos before moving your boxes in.
examples.zh: 搬箱子之前，先用带日期的照片「记录损坏情况」。

examples.en: We documented the damage and emailed the agent the same afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们当天下午就「记录了损坏情况」并邮件发给中介。

collocations: document the damage before moving in

words.enDefinition: small damage from ordinary everyday use over time

examples.en: Faded paint counts as wear and tear, but burns come out of your deposit.
examples.zh: 油漆变旧算「正常损耗」，烫痕可要从押金里扣。

examples.en: The report separates tenant damage from normal wear and tear.
examples.zh: 报告会把租客造成的损坏和「正常损耗」分开列。
